distractors.reason: 'Tall' is used for people and things that are high, such as a tall tree. We don't say 'tall family'.
'Fast' describes speed, as in fast car. We don't use it to describe the number of people in a family.
'Hot' describes temperature, as in hot tea. It is not used with the word family.

example_sentence: I have a ___ family with four children.
l1_interference: Türkçe konuşanlar 'büyük' kelimesini her zaman 'big' ile eşleştirir, ancak bazen 'large family' diyebilirler. İngilizcede aile için doğal olan ifade 'big family'dir.
explanation: In English, 'big' is the natural adjective to describe the size of a family, meaning a family with many members.

related_collocations.example: My uncle is a kind father to his children.
I have a young sister who is six years old.

memory_tip: BIG = large in size (big family, big house) | TALL = high in height (tall tree, tall man)
